scenicChapters.title: Kiyomizu-dera → Nara Palace Site
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 46 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-kozan-ji-nara-palace-site-2.story: From Arashiyama it runs 124 km to Arashiyama; allow about 2 h 08 of riding. It goes by way of Kiyomizu-dera, Nara Palace Site and back through Kiyomizu-dera. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
